desc: Prove the equivalence between legal swapping and existence of two internally vertex-disjoint S–T paths, including the lower bound on total moves.
Derive and verify the minimum-cost-flow construction for two internally vertex-disjoint paths, handling undirected edges and endpoint capacities correctly.
Implement two augmentations of min-cost max-flow efficiently for N,M ≤ 2×10^5.
Check the characterization and algorithm on single edges, trees, cycles, triangles, bridges, articulation points, and the provided samples.
Write the final Python solution with input parsing, complexity analysis, and required code delimiters.
